temporal_audit.association: Full successful BE order and complete original PLT sequence; every from/to/dt print interval and declared/native segment checked

direction_reference.metric_contract: Original fixed metrics i_sn_A is total terminal current into device at SN

current_mapping.initial_note: Current comes from full-coupled device initialization; final zero-time circuit reevaluation is preserved separately and never integrated

current_mapping.sign_chosen_from: Official System direction and original metric semantics, not metric outcome
current_mapping.target_direction: total terminal current into access device through source at SN

temporal_audit.endpoint_rule: Positive circuit first row, proven by exact opposite four-port device TotalCurrent; never chosen by magnitude or metric

initialization.physical_start: Final original zero-time circuit state after full initialization/release; node voltages equal the verified full-coupled state
